why: The count npm run conformance reports today. It is a ratchet, not a target: this number may fall and may not rise, per CLAUDE.md Session Discipline. The one sanctioned rise is layout-manifests, which fires once per route and has no implementation behind it (W-041) — adding a screen adds exactly one, and the session report has to say so.

standing.layout-manifests: one per route with no manifest; the format does not exist yet (W-041)
standing.mock-banner: three screens read from fixtures without saying so
standing.generated-client-only: api-client.ts is the hand-written transport the rule is about
